style: Use this exact character: small glowing mint-green gummy blob, black pixel-LED sunglasses with green dot lenses, small smile, little green flag. Stylized 3D character in a real photographic world, cinematic, 16:9 widescreen. Fill the whole frame with the scene.
negative: deformed character, extra limbs, fingers, text, watermark, blurry

chorus1-1.keyframe: Cinematic macro photo: a smartphone lying in tall grass at golden hour; the character is halfway out of the glowing screen, one stubby arm on the phone's edge, climbing out into a jungle of giant grass blades. Warm backlight, dew, shallow depth of field.
chorus1-1.motion: The small glowing mint-green gummy character in black pixel sunglasses pulls itself up out of the rippling liquid phone screen in three bouncy heaves, one on each beat, pops free and lands in the grass, then raises its little green flag. The camera swoops low through the giant dewy grass blades and rises up into a wide golden-hour park. Warm backlight, lens flare, playful energetic motion.

intro-1.keyframe: Dark bedroom at 2 AM: a man in his thirties (short dark messy hair, light stubble, black-framed glasses, grey hoodie) lies in bed in profile, face lit cold blue by a phone propped on the pillow beside him, the scrolling feed reflected in his glasses, tired eyes. On the phone's glowing screen, tiny, the character stands inside the glass tapping on it from the inside. Deep shadows, blue light, cinematic, no hands in frame.
intro-1.motion: Almost still. The blue light flickers as the feed scrolls; his eyes track the screen. Inside the phone the tiny glowing character taps the glass twice. Very slow push-in toward the phone.
intro-1.foley: two soft glass taps from inside the screen

intro-2.keyframe: Close-up of a phone screen glowing in a dark bedroom, an endless social feed of blurred posts streaming past; the tiny glowing character stands inside the screen in front of the feed, looking out at the viewer, waving its little green flag.
intro-2.motion: The camera pushes forward into the phone screen in three surges, one on each 'down', until the glowing feed fills the frame and the camera passes through the glass into the stream of posts; the little character beckons it in.
intro-2.foley: a deep whoom on each push, the last one opening into a glassy rush

intro-3.keyframe: Abstract: falling through a tunnel of streaking blue and white light, blurred feed posts and notification bubbles stretched into long light streaks, the tiny glowing mint-green character tumbling among them, its green flag fluttering.
intro-3.motion: A fast continuous fall through streaks of light that accelerate and stretch; the character tumbles past the camera; at the very end everything flares to white, ready to match-cut into the verse.
intro-3.foley: the glassy rush continues from intro-2

verse1-1.keyframe: Inside the phone world: an endless vertical canyon built from social feed posts, cold blue and glitchy, notifications drifting like snow; the tiny glowing character points its green flag at the viewer.
verse1-1.motion: Continuing from the bounce: the character struts along the posts toward the camera, pointing its flag at the viewer on 'you'. Posts scroll endlessly up the canyon walls. Glitchy blue flicker.
verse1-1.foley: notification pings scattered through the feed

verse1-2.keyframe: A city skyline made of giant glowing podcast audio waveforms at night inside the phone world, doom headlines scrolling on billboards; the tiny glowing character walks along the top of a waveform ridge.
verse1-2.motion: The character walks the waveform ridge as the waveforms spike red on each doom word, billboards flicker with apocalyptic headlines; slow tracking shot, claustrophobic blue.

verse1-3.keyframe: A cold blue feed landscape with a column of tiny identical figures in dark suits marching in lockstep across it; the tiny glowing character stands beside them holding a little green flag, a warm burst of color blooming where it planted another flag.
verse1-3.motion: Tiny suited figures march in lockstep across the feed; on each 'Green flag' the character plants a flag and a warm burst of color blooms out of the blue; on the second one a dog photo post pops into full color.
verse1-3.foley: tiny marching stomps; a soft pop on each green-flag bloom

verse1-4.keyframe: The tiny glowing character holding a small glowing planet Earth out in front of it with both stubby arms, offering it back, next to a soft fluffy cloud made of glowing green code glyphs floating in the dark blue phone world.
verse1-4.motion: The character shrugs and hands the tiny Earth back out of frame, then flops happily onto the fluffy cloud of soft green code; its glow lights up the dark corners around it.
verse1-4.foley: a little 'boop' as the Earth is handed back, a soft cloud flump

verse1-5.keyframe: Inside the phone world: the tiny glowing character hauling a giant phone charger plug across the frame toward a glowing charging port, straining, cable trailing behind it.
verse1-5.motion: On the word 'charger' the character jams the giant plug into the port; a bright green charge bolt surges out and floods the whole frame.
verse1-5.foley: heavy plug CLICK on 'charger' (29.36), electric surge into a charging chime

prechorus1-3.keyframe: Sunlit kitchen in the morning: the character peeks out from behind a white coffee mug on the counter, much smaller than the mug; behind it a toaster is smoking, the toast burnt black. Warm golden window light, shallow depth of field.
prechorus1-3.motion: The small glowing mint-green character peeks out from behind the coffee mug, ducks back, then peeks out again with a little wave of its green flag, bouncing on the beat. Smoke curls up from the burnt toast. Slow gentle push-in, warm morning light.

prechorus1-1.keyframe: Bedroom at dawn: a man in his thirties (short dark messy hair, light stubble, black-framed glasses, grey hoodie) bolting upright in bed, startled awake as if from a bad dream, soft morning light through the curtains, his phone on the nightstand lit up and buzzing with an incoming call. No hands in frame.
prechorus1-1.motion: He jolts awake and sits up sharply as the phone buzzes on the nightstand, blinking at the morning light, catching his breath; he turns toward the ringing phone. Hard cut in, handheld feel.
prechorus1-1.foley: sharp breath in; phone buzz/ringtone; birds outside
prechorus1-1.note: The charge snapped him awake; Mom's call gets him up. Leaves the phone world.
prechorus1-1.overlay: 'Mom' as the caller name on the phone screen (composited, timed to 'your momma still calls')

prechorus1-2.keyframe: Warm sunlit kitchen in the morning: a phone lying on the wooden counter next to a coffee mug, its screen stacked with group-chat message bubbles; the character lounges on top of the phone like a sun-warmed cat. Real, cozy, golden window light.
prechorus1-2.motion: Group-chat bubbles keep popping up on the phone screen in quick succession; the character lounging on the phone bobs its head to the beat and lazily waves its flag at each new bubble. Gentle slide along the counter.

intro-4.keyframe: (chained: first frame = last frame of intro-3)
intro-4.motion: The fall through the light streaks accelerates even more, the streaks bending into a tunnel; the tiny character spins past the camera; everything flares to pure white on the final beat before the drop.
intro-4.foley: a rising whoosh that ENDS on the drop at 11.53 (the next bar); the echoed 'hey hey hey' is already in the song
intro-4.match_cut_to: intro-5 (land in the phone world out of the white flare)

intro-5.keyframe: Inside the phone world: an endless vertical canyon built from social feed posts, cold blue and glitchy; the tiny glowing character stands on a post mid-bounce, flag raised.
intro-5.motion: Out of the white flare the canyon resolves; the character bounces once on each of the four 'down's, higher each time, then spins to face the camera on 'hey, hey, hey' and points its flag at the viewer.
intro-5.foley: a springy boing on each bounce

theme: The camera gets pulled into the doomscroller's world inside the phone; Blip is there to add color and reset him back to real life.

blip.look: small glowing mint-green gummy blob, black pixel-LED sunglasses with green dot lenses, small smile, little green flag

scroller.look: a man in his thirties, short dark messy hair, light stubble, black-framed glasses, grey hoodie, tired eyes
